intro: At Bethesda Christian Centre, we are all about knowing Jesus and making Him known. These are our statements of faith and practices.

statementOfFaith.title: The Divine Inspiration, Authority, and Sufficiency of the Holy Scriptures
statementOfFaith.summary: The Scriptures are inspired by God and are the final authority for faith and life.

statementOfFaith.title: The Unity of the Godhead
statementOfFaith.summary: There is one God in three Persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, to whom equal honour is due.
statementOfFaith.references: Deuteronomy 6:4; John 1:1–2; John 5:17,22–23; John 14:25–26; John 16:7,27–28; Philippians 2:6; Hebrews 1:1–3,8

statementOfFaith.title: The Incarnation of the Son of God
statementOfFaith.summary: Jesus truly became man, being conceived by the Holy Spirit and born of the virgin Mary.

statementOfFaith.title: The Substitutionary Death of Christ
statementOfFaith.summary: His death was a sacrifice to God and a propitiation for the forgiveness of sins.

statementOfFaith.title: The Resurrection of Christ
statementOfFaith.summary: He was bodily raised from the dead.

statementOfFaith.title: The Ascension and Ongoing Priesthood of Christ
statementOfFaith.summary: He ascended to God’s right hand and now serves as the all-sufficient High Priest of His people.
statementOfFaith.references: Mark 16:19–20; Luke 24:50–51; Acts 1:9; Ephesians 4:8–10; Hebrews 4:14–16; Hebrews 7:25

statementOfFaith.title: The Return of Christ
statementOfFaith.summary: He will return to gather His people and establish His Kingdom.
statementOfFaith.references: John 14:3; 1 Thessalonians 4:13–18; Luke 1:32–33; Isaiah 9:6–7; Daniel 2:44–45; Daniel 7:13–14

statementOfFaith.title: The Sinfulness and Inability of Man
statementOfFaith.summary: Because of Adam’s fall, all humanity is lost, hostile to God, and powerless to do His will.

statementOfFaith.title: The Regenerating and Sanctifying Work of the Holy Spirit
statementOfFaith.summary: The Spirit is essential for new birth and ongoing transformation.

statementOfFaith.title: Justification by Faith Alone
statementOfFaith.summary: Sinners are justified before God solely by faith in Christ.

statementOfFaith.title: The New Birth of the Justified
statementOfFaith.summary: Every justified believer is born of God.

statementOfFaith.title: The Evidence of New Birth
statementOfFaith.summary: True new birth results in a life marked by holiness and good works.

statementOfFaith.title: The Resurrection and Eternal Destiny of All People
statementOfFaith.summary: There will be a bodily resurrection: eternal life for the righteous, and eternal punishment for the unrighteous.
statementOfFaith.references: 1 Corinthians 15:51–57; Philippians 3:20–21; Romans 14:9–10; 2 Corinthians 5:10; Daniel 12:2; Acts 17:31; Revelation 20:11–15

statementOfFaith.title: The Church
statementOfFaith.summary: The universal Church is a gathering of faithful believers united in Christ, in which God’s word is preached and the sacraments are administered according to Christ’s authority.
statementOfFaith.references: Acts 19:32; Hebrews 12:23; 1 Corinthians 14:26; Ephesians 2:20; Ephesians 4:11–12; 1 Timothy 3:15; 1 Corinthians 11:17–34

practices.title: Believer’s Baptism
practices.summary: The baptism of believers, normally by immersion, is observed upon personal confession of faith in the Lord Jesus Christ.

practices.title: The Lord’s Supper
practices.summary: The Lord’s death is remembered through the Breaking of Bread, usually on the first day of the week. All baptised believers whose conduct is in line with their confession of faith are welcomed to the Lord’s Table.
practices.references: Luke 22:14–19; Acts 2:42,46; Acts 20:7; Romans 14:1–9; Romans 15:7; 1 Corinthians 5:6–8; 1 Corinthians 11:23–26

practices.title: Priesthood of All Believers
practices.summary: Every believer is a priest before God without the need for any human mediator.

practices.title: The Appointment of Elders
practices.summary: Elders are recognised and appointed from among male members who are gifted by God for spiritual leadership, teaching of the word, and pastoral care.

practices.title: The Appointment of Deacons
practices.summary: Deacons are appointed to serve the church in practical matters, supporting the ministry of the word and prayer.
